_readme: Curated flavor for the Empires of Bharat trump cards. KRISHNA CAN EDIT THIS FILE FREELY. Each key is the empire's exact name from kingdoms.json. 'native' is the name in its own script (shown under the empire name; leave '' to hide the line). 'greatestRuler' + 'epithet' feed the 'Greatest ruler: NAME — epithet' flavor line (5-8 word epithets read best). If an empire has no entry here, the card falls back to the founding ruler's name from dynasty_rulers.json with no epithet. Run the build after editing so the file gets a fresh cache stamp.

India.epithet: first Prime Minister of the Republic

British Raj.epithet: Empress of India, crown of empire

East India Company.epithet: merchant-soldier who seized Bengal at Plassey

Mughal Empire.epithet: unifier of Hindustan, architect of empire

Delhi Sultanate.epithet: conqueror who repelled the Mongol storms

Maratha Empire.epithet: founder of Hindavi Swarajya, master of forts

Ghurid Empire.epithet: victor of Tarain, maker of sultanates

Sur Empire.epithet: builder of the Grand Trunk Road

Hyderabad.epithet: founder of the Asaf Jahi dynasty

Bahmani Sultanate.epithet: scholar-sultan of the Deccan's first empire

Vijayanagara Empire.epithet: poet-king at the empire's golden noon

Bengal (Nawab).epithet: first Nawab, master of Bengal's revenues

Seuna (Yadava).epithet: Yadava power at its widest reach

Kalat (Khanate).epithet: the Great Khan of the Baloch

Durrani (Afghan) Empire.epithet: father of Afghanistan, victor at Panipat

Golconda (Qutb Shahi).epithet: builder of Hyderabad and the Charminar

Sikh Empire.epithet: Lion of Punjab, unifier of the misls

Kakatiya dynasty.epithet: warrior queen of Warangal's golden age

Bijapur (Adil Shahi).epithet: patron of music, the Jagadguru Badshah

Dogra J&K.epithet: founder of the Jammu & Kashmir state

Sena dynasty.epithet: last Hindu king of old Bengal

Ahmadnagar Sultanate.epithet: the regent who defied the Mughals

Chahamana (Chauhan).epithet: hero of Tarain, last of Delhi's Rajputs

Baloch.epithet: legendary khan of the Baloch epics

Jaunpur Sultanate.epithet: patron of the Sharqi golden age

Eastern Ganga dynasty.epithet: builder of the Konark Sun Temple

Mysore Sultanate (Hyder Ali & Tipu).epithet: Tiger of Mysore, pioneer of rocketry

Kalhora (Sindh).epithet: founder of Hyderabad on the Indus

Nagpur (Bhonsle).epithet: Maratha lord of the eastern marches
